description: This source file defines data structures and a singleton class for managing communication channel statuses and configurations within an application, including various integrations like WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, and Google Chat. It includes models for channel state snapshots, configuration snapshots, and a store class that manages the state and metadata for channels.

classes.name: ChannelsStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the state, configuration, and metadata related to communication channels, providing methods to resolve labels, icons, and ordered channel list.

methods.name: channelMetaEntry
methods.description: Retrieves metadata entry for a specific channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelLabel
methods.description: Resolves and returns a user-friendly label for a given channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelDetailLabel
methods.description: Resolves and returns a detailed label for a given channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelSystemImage
methods.description: Resolves and returns a system image (icon) for a given channel ID.

methods.name: orderedChannelIds
methods.description: Returns the list of channel IDs ordered based on metadata or default order.
